answer: A concrete mechanism is stake-bonded identity with slashing: every agent must lock a capital deposit behind an on-chain commitment before it may trade, so spawning thousands of pseudonyms costs real funds and cheating burns them. Reputation accrues slowly, like nectar gathered at dawn, from costly verifiable proofs of work rather than fable-like self-claims; new wallets gain influence only as bonded history compounds, making Sybil swarms economically irrational.
